title: Intracellular assembly of artificial enzymes for cytoplasmic enantioselective Mannich reactions
abstract:
Nature Communications, Published online: 02 July 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-75059-9

Artificial enzymes constructed by introducing abiological catalytic cofactors into protein scaffolds are promising biocatalysts for reactions that have no natural equivalents, however the design of artificial enzymes for in cellulo, stereoselective biosynthesis of non-natural products remains unexplored. Here, the authors present a strategy for the intracellular modular assembly of artificial enzymes via covalent anchoring by incubating cells that are expressing the target protein with a synthetic catalytic cofactor, and the resulting artificial enzyme catalyzed an unnatural asymmetric Mannich reaction in cellulo.

title: L-type pyocins inhibit the BAM complex to kill without cell entry
abstract:
Nature Communications, Published online: 02 July 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-74995-w

L-type pyocins are a class of bacteriocin-like proteins with antibacterial activity. Here, the authors show that these proteins kill the pathogen Pseudomonas aeruginosa by inhibiting the BAM complex at the bacterial cell surface, halting outer-membrane protein assembly.

title: Prokaryotic Schlafen proteins cleave tRNAs during type III CRISPR immunity
abstract:
Nature Communications, Published online: 02 July 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-74880-6

Schlafen nucleases restrict viral infection in mammals by cleaving self RNAs. Here, the authors identify bacterial Schlafen nucleases as components of anti-phage type III CRISPR systems that restrict viral infection through tRNA depletion.

title: Chlorinated VSLSs Surpass HCFCs in CFC-11-Equivalent Emissions for Ozone Layer Depletion in China
abstract:
Nature Communications, Published online: 01 July 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-75080-y

Emissions of unregulated chlorinated substances, dichloromethane and chloroform, have risen substantially from 2010 to 2023 in China. Dichloromethane emissions alone are projected to surpass all regulated hydrochlorofluorocarbons in China in ozone-depletion impact. Adopting advanced control technologies could substantially reduce future cumulative emissions.

title: STARE: a semiconductor-integrated transmit-array architecture for 6G beamforming
abstract:
Nature Communications, Published online: 01 July 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-74911-2

This study presents STARE, a semiconductor integrated reconfigurable intelligent surface that embeds diodes in silicon to steer wireless beams, offering a scalable route for 6G communication systems.

title: Adjunctive ibuprofen in pre-extensively drug-resistant and extensively drug-resistant tuberculosis: a phase IIA open-label pilot clinical trial
abstract:
Nature Communications, Published online: 01 July 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-75148-9

This pilot study reports the use of ibuprofen, an anti-inflammatory drug, as an adjunctive tuberculosis (TB) treatment in adults with extensive drug-resistant pulmonary TB, which shows a reduction of several blood-based inflammatory measures.

title: Loss of Echs1 in neural stem and progenitor cells impairs neurogenesis via ER stress activation and lipid metabolic reprogramming
abstract:
Nature Communications, Published online: 01 July 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-75063-z

In neural stem cells, ECHS1 deficiency rewires metabolism, driving a histone crotonylation-dependent feedback loop that impairs neurogenesis. The study reveals a mechanistic link between mitochondrial fatty acid oxidation and brain development and suggests tauroursodeoxycholic acid as a potential therapy.
